docs.title: Professional Summary
docs.text:
I am an undergraduate student specializing in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, with a strong interest in MLOps, AI Automation, Cloud Computing, and Open Source technologies. I am committed to continuously enhancing my technical skills through hands-on learning, real-world implementation, and collaborative development.

As an MLOps Open Source Contributor at iGradAI Labs Private Limited, I worked on practical assignments involving AI workflow automation, cloud technologies, technical documentation, and open-source development. Throughout the internship, I gained hands-on experience with n8n for workflow automation, AWS Cloud Quest for cloud fundamentals, Git & GitHub for version control, and MkDocs with Material for MkDocs for creating and deploying technical documentation.

This portfolio documents the work completed during the internship, including projects, technical tasks, tools explored, and the key knowledge and practical experience gained throughout the program.

docs.title: Internship Reflection
docs.text:
The internship at iGradAI Labs Private Limited provided an excellent opportunity to gain practical exposure to modern software development practices and industry-standard technologies. It enabled me to strengthen my understanding of AI Automation, MLOps, Cloud Computing, Open Source Development, and Technical Documentation through hands-on learning and real-world assignments.

Throughout the internship, I worked with technologies including n8n, AWS Cloud Quest, Git, GitHub, MkDocs, and Material for MkDocs, while also developing skills in workflow automation, documentation as code, version control, and collaborative development.

The experience significantly enhanced my technical proficiency, analytical thinking, documentation practices, and problem-solving abilities. More importantly, it provided valuable insight into professional development workflows and reinforced the importance of continuous learning and adaptability in the rapidly evolving technology landscape.

Santhosh, for his continuous guidance, encouragement, and technical support throughout the internship. I also extend my appreciation to the entire team for fostering a collaborative learning environment that contributed significantly to my professional growth.
